This breakdown will clarify how [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-11|crypto]] payment gateways can provide a solution, reducing dependency on conventional platforms and allowing creators to retain more revenue.

For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-14. content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

A crypto payment gateway is an infrastructure service that allows digital creators to accept payments in cryptocurrencies for their products. Unlike traditional payment processors that charge high fees and impose restrictions, a crypto gateway like NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction. This drastically reduces costs, meaning more revenue stays with creators. For instance, if you sell a $97 ebook, using a service like Gumroad could cost you $9.70, while NOWPayments would only take $0.49. This difference becomes significant when your sales volume increases, empowering creators to reinvest in their work rather than losing profits to fees.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a crypto payment gateway involves several components working seamlessly together. First, you host your digital products on a platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare, which provides a reliable and cost-effective hosting solution. When a customer makes a purchase, a backend service such as Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers processes the transaction and communicates with NOWPayments to verify the payment. Once confirmed, the product is automatically delivered to the customer. This setup ensures that you maintain control over your products and customer data while offering a smooth purchasing experience.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable or prohibitively expensive. Whether you're a musician selling beats, an educator offering online courses, or a designer providing templates, this system allows you to sell your work directly to customers without relying on platforms that charge high fees or impose restrictions. By adopting this architecture, creators can regain financial sovereignty and ensure that they receive the full value of their work.
Cut your transaction fees from 10% to 0.5% with NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

There are several key components in building a crypto payment infrastructure. First, you need a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare, which allows you to publish your digital products online for free. Next, you will use a backend solution like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle payment logic and order processing. NOWPayments serves as the crypto payment gateway, handling multiple cryptocurrencies and ensuring seamless transactions. Finally, utilizing storage solutions such as Google Drive for product delivery ensures that customers receive their purchases automatically and without delay.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own sovereign digital commerce stack, start by selecting a hosting platform, like GitHub Pages, to serve your digital products. Next, create a Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Worker to handle payment logic. Integrate NOWPayments to facilitate cryptocurrency transactions. After setting up your payment infrastructure, use Google Drive to store and automate the delivery of your products. By following these steps, you can achieve a fully operational online store that empowers you to sell directly to your customers without the constraints of traditional payment platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept various cryptocurrencies directly, minimizing fees and maximizing your profit. By leveraging tools such as GitHub Pages for hosting and automated delivery through Google Apps Script, you can create an efficient sales process without traditional platform constraints.
Retain full ownership of your data and products — no third-party dependencies.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those seeking to build their own digital download store that operates exclusively on cryptocurrency, exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197) is essential. This kit includes all necessary blueprints and templates to establish a comprehensive sovereign commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I start selling digital downloads without a platform?

You can start by hosting your products on platforms like GitHub Pages. Implement a payment solution using NOWPayments for transaction processing. This allows you to sell directly and retain more profit.
What are the fees associated with using a crypto payment gateway?
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than traditional platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. This means more revenue remains with you after each sale.
Is it difficult to set up a digital store using crypto payments?

Setting up a digital store with crypto payments is straightforward. With tools like GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for transactions, you can establish a fully operational store without extensive technical knowledge.
Can I sell multiple types of digital products with this setup?
Yes, this infrastructure supports various digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, and software. You can customize your store to fit your specific offerings.
What happens to my data after deployment?
Once your infrastructure is deployed, you retain full ownership and control over your data and products. COREMERCH does not have access to your store after delivery.
